tagline.en_US: Plex Media Server organizes personal video, music, and photo collections into a centralized library.

description.en_US: Plex Media Server organizes personal video, music, and photo collections into a centralized library. It streams media content to phones, tablets, streaming devices, gaming consoles, and smart TVs. The server also supports on-the-fly transcoding to deliver media seamlessly across different client devices.
